gaps: P0: none (#1 is a fabric detail of van Eyck’s van der Paele Madonna). P5: only #30, left out for its date.
notes: P1 alternatives: the Braun and Hogenberg bird’s-eye plan (best colored copy #7, 1572, small file; #2 1577 uncolored, large); the Wyngaerde panorama is the stronger true view. P2 alternatives: Josua de Grave’s pale drawing of the skyline dated 2 April 1677 (#11) and the anonymous Musea Brugge painting from Sint-Kruis (#12, about 1681–1700, city small in the distance). P4 alternative: #24, Groenerei (‘Quai vert’) with bridge and Belfry. #30 (Gilbert von Canal, Minnewater with the Church of Our Lady) is dated only ‘by 1927’, the year the painter died. P6 is weak: #34/#35 (2023 Markt) are crowded with tourists; #36 has scaffolding.
